title: Create tenant onboarding wizard with plan selection and account setup
acceptance_criteria: Multi-step wizard: step 1 — choose plan (Free/Pro/Enterprise), step 2 — set tenant name and subdomain
Subdomain availability checked in real-time via API call
Plan cards with feature comparison visible at each tier
Progress indicator showing current step and total steps
Onboarding completion redirects to /dashboard with success toast
Back navigation allowed within wizard without losing state
Responsive at all breakpoints, follows 4-stage design workflow
